supported_ubuntu.note: Ubuntu LTS releases on which Docker Engine and the NVIDIA toolkit are installed from their apt repositories (Linux host, and the Sprut distribution on Windows). Anything else is UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE. Provisional: the accepted releases are fixed at S-1.

placeholders.name: system32
placeholders.description: Windows system directory from the OS API (GetSystemDirectoryW), never from PATH or an environment variable; only as the prefix of argv[0].

placeholders.name: distro_name
placeholders.description: Name of the Sprut WSL distribution, a client constant (working name sprut).

placeholders.name: distro_base_path
placeholders.description: Install directory of the Sprut distribution under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Sprut\wsl\, a client constant.

placeholders.name: verified_file
placeholders.description: Path of the copy made and checked by the preceding verify_source: owned by the principal that runs the command (root / the elevated helper), in a directory only that principal can write, its SHA-256 equal to step.source.sha256. Commands never use the downloaded file itself.

placeholders.name: codename
placeholders.description: Ubuntu codename of the target system, one of supported_ubuntu.codenames.

description.ru: SHA-256 загруженного файла, вычисленный процессом, который его использует (для шагов с правами — сам elevated helper/процесс под sudo), равен step.source.sha256. Шаг без source допустим только для kind с необязательным source (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, это указано в заголовке).
description.en: The SHA-256 of the downloaded file, computed by the process that uses it (for privileged steps the elevated helper / the sudo process itself), equals step.source.sha256. A step without source is allowed only for kinds whose source is optional (wsl.exe downloads; the title says so).

description.ru: Кодовое имя Ubuntu есть в supported_ubuntu.codenames, архитектура — supported_ubuntu.architecture.
description.en: The Ubuntu codename is in supported_ubuntu.codenames and the architecture equals supported_ubuntu.architecture.

description.ru: Пользователь процесса клиента ({name, uid} по uid процесса, не из переменных окружения) равен step.target_user.
description.en: The user of the client process ({name, uid} from the process uid, never from environment variables) equals step.target_user.

description.ru: Дистрибутив, зарегистрированный под step.distro.name, перечитан перед вызовом и его BasePath равен step.distro.base_path (иначе FOREIGN_RESOURCE); если он не зарегистрирован — PLAN_STALE.
description.en: The distribution registered under step.distro.name is re-read before the call and its BasePath equals step.distro.base_path (otherwise FOREIGN_RESOURCE); if it is not registered, PLAN_STALE.

description.ru: SHA-256 текущего .wslconfig (или absent) равен step.wslconfig_file.sha256: файл не менялся после показа плана.
description.en: The SHA-256 of the current .wslconfig (or absent) equals step.wslconfig_file.sha256: the file did not change since the plan was shown.

description.ru: Задачи Sprut завершены (drain), и непосредственно перед перезапуском пользователь отдельно подтвердил его в диалоге, показывающем запущенные дистрибутивы WSL (CR04). Согласие с планом это подтверждение не заменяет.
description.en: Sprut tasks were drained, and right before the restart the user separately confirmed it in a dialog that lists the running WSL distributions (CR04). Plan consent does not replace this confirmation.

title.ru: Включить компонент Windows «Подсистема Windows для Linux»
title.en: Enable the Windows feature Windows Subsystem for Linux

step_kinds.note: CW03. Run by the elevated helper.

title.en: Enable the Windows feature Virtual Machine Platform

step_kinds.note: CW03. Run by the elevated helper.

title.en: Install WSL from the official source

title_without_source.ru: Установить WSL средствами wsl.exe (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, Sprut не проверяет её хеш)
title_without_source.en: Install WSL with wsl.exe (wsl.exe downloads it; Sprut does not verify its hash)

step_kinds.note: CW03. With source: the client's pinned package, verified by the elevated helper. Without source: wsl.exe downloads, unverified by Sprut, and the title says so. The path is fixed at S-1; source prefix provisional, to confirm at S-1.

title_without_source.ru: Обновить WSL средствами wsl.exe (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, Sprut не проверяет её хеш)
title_without_source.en: Update WSL with wsl.exe (wsl.exe downloads it; Sprut does not verify its hash)

step_kinds.note: CW03. Separate plan step for WSL_OUTDATED; source as for install_wsl.

title.ru: Удалить повреждённый дистрибутив WSL Sprut (данные внутри него будут потеряны)
title.en: Remove the damaged Sprut WSL distribution (data inside it will be lost)

step_kinds.note: CW04. Only the Sprut distribution, verified by its BasePath; needs the separate distro_removal acknowledgement; immediately followed by import_distro. An export/backup option before removal is planned.

title.ru: Создать дистрибутив WSL Sprut из образа Ubuntu
title.en: Create the Sprut WSL distribution from the Ubuntu image

step_kinds.note: CW04. Pinned Ubuntu LTS rootfs, source.sha256 = SHA-256 of the archive. Source prefixes provisional, to confirm at S-1 (Q10).

title.en: Enable systemd in the Sprut distribution

step_kinds.note: CW05. Restarts only the Sprut distribution.

title.en: Add the official Docker apt repository

step_kinds.note: Spec 7.4 item 2, CW05. source = repository signing key; the key is trusted only for this repository (signed-by), never added to the global trust store. Source prefix provisional, to confirm at S-1.

Spec 7.4 item 2, CW05. Package versions are those of the repository at run time (apt verifies them with the scoped key). Conflicting packages are never removed automatically (ACTION_REQUIRED). dockerd listens only on its unix socket: no daemon.json hosts entry with tcp://, no -H tcp:// (checked in ENGINE_CHECK).

title.ru: Добавить пользователя в группу docker (равносильно правам root)
title.en: Add the user to the docker group (equivalent to root access)

step_kinds.note: Spec 7.4 item 3. Never silently: separate docker_group acknowledgement; a new login is required afterwards (RELOGIN_REQUIRED, exit code 5).

Spec 7.4 item 1, CW09. Optional, by separate consent; source = repository signing key, scoped with signed-by. The NVIDIA driver is never installed or replaced. Source prefix provisional, to confirm at S-1.

title.ru: Запустить Docker Engine и включить его автозапуск
title.en: Start Docker Engine and enable it at boot

title.ru: Изменить ресурсы WSL в .wslconfig (действует на все дистрибутивы WSL)
title.en: Change WSL resources in .wslconfig (affects all WSL distributions)

step_kinds.note: CR01-CR04. Only the managed [wsl2] keys, with backup and atomic write; wslconfig_file binds the file state shown to the user (CR03).

title.ru: Изменить максимальный размер диска дистрибутива Sprut
title.en: Change the maximum disk size of the Sprut distribution

step_kinds.note: CR01, CR02. Sprut distribution only; never .wslconfig defaultVhdSize.
CR04. A separate confirmed action at execution time (precondition wsl_restart_confirmed), after a drain.
Pull by ImageReference in the IMAGE_PULL state (guards image_allowlisted, image_in_consented_plan), not in INSTALLING.
